items.item_text: Employment is subject to a criminal background check.
Demonstrated experience with the operation of a personal computer and various software applications and packages, such as MS Word and Excel.

Excellent organizational skills to order and maintain lab equipment and supplies. Experience with general lab maintenance, including cleaning and restocking supplies. Experience working and maintaining a sterile environment.

UCSD Department of Otolaryngology is among the leading Otolaryngology – Head & Neck Surgery Departments in the country. The Department offers challenging career opportunities in the diverse areas of state-of-the-art clinical services, advance educational programs, and cutting-edge research. The department is committed to offering a dynamic learning environment and growing opportunities to its talented and dedicate employees.

The incumbent will provide comprehensive support for a research projects aimed at disorders that impact the head and neck region. Responsibilities will include patient recruitment, protocol management, tracking study participants, data management and assistance with budget and resource management. Projects will include a variety of different projects that focus on diverse topics including but not limited to hearing loss, airway stenosis, swallowing, and nasal disease. The associate will have the opportunity to work with a number of physician scientists who are leaders in their respective field. The department requests but does not require at least a two-year time commitment
Willingness to learn new techniques and tasks.

Theoretical knowledge of a life science in a field related to the research being conducted. Related fields may include any of the following fields of study: molecular biology, biology, immunology, and/or biochemistry.

Strong communication skills (both verbal and written) needed to interact professionally and effectively in the work environment, as well as effectively and accurately document research procedures. Demonstrated ability to read, comprehend and discuss research materials. as well as effectively and accurately document research procedures. Demonstrated ability to read, comprehend and discuss research materials. Demonstrated ability to assist in the writing of papers for publication and research proposals.
Ability to coordinate studies with the lab and other departments. Demonstrated skill to plan and organize work assignments in an efficient and productive manner.
Ability to read, interpret and apply protocols in conducting research. Demonstrated ability to following experimental protocols.
Demonstrated skill in accurate record keeping and ability to organize, analyze, and calculate data.
Enthusiasm for learning and a genuine interest in scientific research. Willingness and ability to learn new skills, research methods, and scientific principles.
